title: Mycelium Murmurs
author: CMDR Snickerdoodlez
description: Dark random sounds for the Fungoida set: three slow ambient tracks, two short pieces that greet you at the last system of a plotted route, the odd drip, creak and spore puff, and sometimes a burst of spores when you arrive in a system. Plays alongside any sound pack.
changes: Journey's end: two short arrival pieces that always play when you reach the last system of a plotted route (the track playing fades out for them)
A third track, Glowcap Hollow: a glowing forest after dark, warmer than the other two
